observation.command:
for i in $(seq 1 11); do
  n=$(ps aux | grep "compose.*pull" | grep -v grep | wc -l)
  if [ "$n" -eq 0 ]; then echo "PULL PROCESS ENDED at iteration $i"; break; fi
  sleep 50
done
echo "=== errors ==="; grep -iE "denied|forbidden|unauthenticated|error|not found|failed|manifest" /tmp/pull.log | head -10
echo "=== tail ==="; tail -3 /tmp/pull.log
echo "=== images ==="; docker images 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "audiominer|redis|opencode"
